lesson: Broad conservative-author coverage kept the score positive, but Clarence Thomas was underweighted. In opinion-authorship markets, retain the full plausible bloc while giving more weight to case-specific assignment and authorship-balance clues.
The named Italian consul was a better anchor than generic nationality and geographic priors; reallocating to Italy produced a strong score.
A high-confidence consensus favorite with one concrete challenger modestly hedged was well calibrated.
Argument-coalition evidence correctly removed liberal authors, and Gorsuch's central questioning justified placing him first.
Treating the race as close while giving Lasher a slight local-institutional advantage proved appropriate.
